name: Excelsior Alimentos S.A.
summary: Excelsior Alimentos S.A. produces and commercializes industrialized meat products. It operates in two segments, Cold Processed Products and Frozen Processed Products. The company offers pâté in tubes, sausages, hams, cold cuts, mortadellas, pâtés, pizzas, cheese breads, morcelas, lasagnas, hamburgers, and cold fries. It distributes its products through retailers, distributors, resellers, and small commercial stores in the South region of Brazil, which primarily includes Rio Grande do Sul, Santa Catarina, and Paraná. The company was formerly known as Baumhardt Irmãos S.A. and changed its name to Excelsior Alimentos S.A. in 2003. The company was founded in 1891 and is headquartered in Santa Cruz do Sul, Brazil. Excelsior Alimentos S.A. is a subsidiary of Seara Alimentos S.A.
